name: foodfloods-microservices
description: FoodyGo - Event-Driven Microservices Architecture with Apache Kafka & Docker

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,RESTAURANT,ORDER,PAYMENT,DELIVERY,NOTIF,SUPPORT" -c "blue,magenta,yellow,cyan,green,red,gray,white" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:restaurant" "npm run dev:order" "npm run dev:payment" "npm run dev:delivery" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:support"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,RESTAURANT,ORDER,PAYMENT,DELIVERY,NOTIF,SUPPORT" -c "blue,magenta,yellow,cyan,green,red,gray,white" "node services/api-gateway/server.js" "node services/auth-service/server.js" "node services/restaurant-service/server.js" "node services/order-service/server.js" "node services/payment-service/server.js" "node services/delivery-service/server.js" "node services/notification-service/server.js" "node services/support-service/server.js"
